about: Per-corpus unexplained-delta baseline for the refraction differential (#3211). `--ci` gates the committed `excerpts` (what CI runs); `--corpus NAME` gates the `full` pinned corpora (local, needs a fetch+scan). A run fails when it ADDS unexplained deltas over these counts; --update-baseline blesses the matching scope (existing notes are carried forward). Every entry with unexplained > 0, or no answer key, needs a note saying why it stands, with the issue that owns the fix. `by_cause` is recorded for visibility and does not gate.
